redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, searches, API metadata or viewers retained as validation receipts; access does not imply bulk extraction or redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose product-specific licence permits the recorded fields and derivatives, with attribution, approval, edition, coverage, schema, CRS and digest pinned.
Credentialed, application-reviewed, purpose-limited, request-delivered or otherwise restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Survey-disclaimed, non-commercial, no-modification, personal, ownership, rights, unclear-license or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.production_scope: Official system metadata establishing that the five-digit National Basic District Number has been used as the postcode since 1 August 2015 and describing digit structure. It supplies no current assignment row or geometry.

Pinned credentialed API request and response may establish an address-to-five-digit-postcode result under its service-key, traffic, purpose and public-field conditions. A query result is not geometry or a bulk redistribution grant.

sources.provider: Ministry of the Interior and Safety road-name address system
sources.production_scope: Exact approved electronic-map National Basic District layer may supply the canonical polygon or multipolygon for the same current five-digit number. Product, application, identity and purpose approval, exact KOGL marking, allowed derivatives, coverage, validity, topology, source CRS and digest must be pinned.

sources.provider: Ministry of the Interior and Safety road-name address system
sources.production_scope: Pinned approved API responses may supply public road-name address components, English address, five-digit postcode, road and administrative codes, 25-digit building management number, road-address management number and public building name. They supply no footprint unless a separate geometry artifact and exact relationship are proven.

sources.provider: Ministry of the Interior and Safety road-name address system
sources.production_scope: The exact public Building DB may supply building-level public address and lot fields and 25-digit building management numbers under its artifact-specific terms. Apartment-complex and detailed-building relations remain explicit; no footprint, resident, household or unrestricted detailed-unit output is inferred.

sources.provider: Ministry of the Interior and Safety road-name address system
sources.production_scope: Exact approved electronic-map layers may provide buildings, building groups, entrances, roads, basic districts and administrative geometry. Each layer retains its identifier and artifact-specific source CRS, approval, purpose, KOGL marking, public-field allowlist and derivative rights. An entrance without a documented building relation is only a point candidate.

sources.provider: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
sources.production_scope: Exact GIS Integrated Building Information combines official topographic building geometry with public building-register attributes. Building display still requires a stable documented identifier or reviewed crosswalk to the Juso address; private, owner, resident, rights, value and tax fields are excluded even if technically present elsewhere.

sources.provider: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport
sources.production_scope: The exact nationwide snapshot is reference-only continuous cadastral drawing, not survey data, and its recorded KOGL Type 4 terms require attribution, non-commercial use and no modification. Other cadastral products have separate terms and cannot broaden this product. Parcel evidence never becomes postcode or building identity.

artifact_partitions.rule: Korea Post assignments and query receipts remain separate from geometry.
Exact current MOIS district polygons use the same five-digit key and are the only default canonical postal surface.
Juso public address components and 25-digit building management identifiers remain typed address evidence.
Juso or MOLIT building geometry is emitted only through an explicit stable relationship or reviewed crosswalk.
Administrative and parcel geometry never substitute for postal or building evidence.
Any model, interpolation or fallback surface stays separate, derived, uncertainty-bearing and non-canonical.
Residents, households, owners, rights, occupants, recipients, detailed private units, values, taxes, shipments and query histories never become public output.
